newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Tai Hong says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Tai Hong says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Consumer goods importer Cheung Tai Hong Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was in negotiations on buying a stake in a mineral water plant in China from company chairman Wong Chun Hong.

"The company is now considering a possible acquisition of interest in a Hong Kong incorporated company which owns a 55 percent interest in a mineral water plant in Shenzhen," the company said in a statement.
The Hong Kong company is owned by Wong, it said, adding that talks were at a preliminary stage and no binding agreement had been reached. It gave no further details.
Cheung Tai Hong shares were up HK$0.13 or 8.07 percent to HK$1.74 in late morning.
